title: CBDT Exempts IRRI Payments from TDS/TCS Provisions
content:
# CBDT Exempts IRRI Payments from TDS/TCS Provisions

Ek important update hai! Government ne International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) ko milne wale payments par Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) aur Tax Collected at Source (TCS) se exemption announce kiya hai.

Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Notification No. 138/2026, dated October 28, 2026, ke through yeh relief provide kiya hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **What is exempted?** Payments received by the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) have been exempted from the provisions of Chapter XIX of the Income-tax Act, 2025. Chapter XIX primarily deals with TDS and TCS.
*   **Under which authority?** This notification has been issued under the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 400 of the Income-tax Act, 2025.
*   **Conditions Apply:** Yeh exemption kuch specific conditions par nirbhar karegi, jo United Nations (Privileges and Immunities) Act, 1947, aur Ministry of External Affairs ke Notification No. S.O. 3230(E) dated October 3, 2017, mein specified hain.
*   **Effective Date:** The notification comes into force from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.
*   **Gazette Reference:** The notification is referred to as S.O. 5855(E).

Basically, iska matlab hai ki IRRI ko milne wale certain payments par ab TDS/TCS deduct ya collect nahi kiya jayega, provided ki specified conditions fulfill ho rahi hon.
